verse.verse_1: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the Owners of the Elephant
verse.verse_2: Did He not make their plot go astray
verse.verse_3: And He sent against them birds, in flocks (Ababil).
verse.verse_4: Striking them with stones of Sijjil.
verse.verse_5: And He made them like `Asf, Ma'kul.
